note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, as listed on 18 November 2026 by Exophase and PSNProfiles and cross-checked by Planet GTA 6, Output Lag and GTA Vibes. Guides are written in my own words for this entry; each one names its sources and never copies their text. The game launched on 19 November 2026, so a few exact counts and spots are still being confirmed by the community — where that is the case the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in this guide in order (story, then strangers, then collectibles and activities, then the money and robbery clean-up) and it will pop last. On Xbox the same achievement is worth 0 Gamerscore, because the other 54 already add up to 1,000.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Gone Fishing early in the story. Just play the story in order and it unlocks when the mission ends. The mission name itself is a story spoiler, which is why this trophy stays hidden on PlayStation until you earn it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, visit the meditation spot on Lucia's balcony — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is reported to disappear once the chapter closes, so do it while you are still in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 2. The asterisks are in the official name itself, as PlayStation publishes it. From Chapter 2 both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens up most of the free-roam trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 3. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save per chapter is your safety net for anything chapter-limited.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission of Chapter 4. By now the map is fully open, so between story missions is a good time to clear the exploration and collectible trophies (The Goodtime State, Whip It Good, You WAiNKer!) while you are travelling anyway.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and one of only two Gold trophies: finish the final mission of Chapter 5. Keep a manual save right before the final mission — guides recommend it because there is no mission replay and the ending has choices (see Actions Speak Louder). After the credits, free roam stays open for the clean-up stages.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Named story-mission trophies like this one unlock by playing the story in order — no side requirement, no special approach needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in the story are separate from the free-roam bank-vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal counts — this one is a scripted story mission, so it unlocks by playing through it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it unlocks at the end of that mission — play the story in order and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Headliners. The trophy name is the stylised spelling PlayStation publishes, with no vowels.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, the free-roam trophy for making an unscheduled departure at the same airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Named-mission trophies unlock at the mission's end, so no extra objective is needed — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second Gold trophy and the hardest grind in the list: reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist. That checklist is separate from the trophies — earning every other trophy does not automatically reach 100%. Guides put the platinum at roughly 200 hours, with the story alone taking around 60 hours, so treat this as the final stage: finish the story, clear every collectible, activity and stranger strand in this guide, then check the in-game completion percentage and mop up whatever it still lists.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and similar driving feats, tracked cumulatively across free roam. This is a volume trophy: it builds up naturally while driving between everything else, so do not grind it early. If it is the last one left, chain stunt jumps and long highway runs; every stunt the game registers counts toward the 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once — one race, one fishing trip, one arcade game, one shooting-range challenge, and so on through the activities this guide lists. It is a sampler trophy: it rewards breadth, not mastery, so dip into each activity as you meet it instead of finishing one before starting the next.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit every shooting range across Leonida and work through each challenge until gold — the ranges are repeatable, so a failed run costs nothing but time. Use Combat Focus to steady your aim, and clear the easier challenges first so you learn each range's layout before chasing gold on the hard ones.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every drone-race location in Leonida. The exact number of locations is still being mapped by the community after launch — check the in-game activity list and the Top Fun markers on the map, and tick each location off as you win it. Drone races are repeatable, so learn a course's turns on a first attempt, then race it clean for the win.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race markers across Leonida and vary the event each time; street races, off-road and any other race type all count as long as the event itself is one you have not won before. The Top Fun drone wins count toward their own trophy, not this one.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge — fishing is a timing activity, so watch the line tension and reel steadily rather than mashing. Losing costs nothing: the challenge can be retried until you beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade machine through to its end. Arcades are scattered around Vice City and the wider state; pick the simplest cabinet first. Finishing counts, winning or scoring high does not matter for this trophy.

trophies.guide: Complete Andy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida — look for the stranger marker, play each mission in order, and the trophy unlocks at the end of the strand. trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Play the strand's missions in order as they unlock around Leonida's coast and waterways. It counts as one of the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks needs.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands are free-roam side content, not story missions — start them from the stranger marker and follow each mission as it unlocks. It counts as one of the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks needs.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands in total. The named stranger trophies — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — are five of them, so finish those strands and find three more strangers across Leonida to reach eight. Explore the map's stranger markers between story chapters rather than leaving all eight for after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the one trophy the launch guides flag as possibly missable: the meditation spot on Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 is reported to disappear after that chapter, and there is no mission replay, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net, and clear each new meditation spot as soon as you find it instead of saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger strand. Look for Bret's marker in Leonida's wilder areas, follow his strand, and take the hunt when it is offered — bring a rifle and track the animal rather than rushing it. It counts toward the stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, interiors and out in the world — so pick cards up whenever you pass them instead of hunting all of them at the end. Track which sets you have finished in the in-game collection screen and focus on the set closest to completion next.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK marks are the game's check-in points: open the app at each marked location and register it, then move on — revisiting the same place does not count twice. Fold this into exploration (The Goodtime State) and vehicle discovery (Whip It Good) so one trip across the map advances three trophies at once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — the small objectives that sit beside the main activities (stunt totals, race wins, collectible milestones and the like). It accumulates across everything else in this guide, so check the challenge list late in the clean-up and finish the 50th with the easiest ones left: short, repeatable challenges beat long grinds for the final few.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Do it in the countryside, away from the city centre: get the wanted level up with your partner in the car, then break line of sight, take back roads and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Your partner must be with you when the heat drops, so do not let them get separated during the chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three close shops first, keep a fast car parked outside each one, and drive straight to the next — the wanted level must stay active the whole time, so do not stop to fight the police or hide. If the stars drop, the chain resets and you start again from shop one.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each one and it counts as discovered. Variety is the whole trick: try every car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass instead of sticking to one favourite. Fold it into exploration and the WAiNK check-ins, and use the in-game vehicle list to see which types you have not found yet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a moment with five or more enemies close together — a gang shootout or a police stand-off — then trigger Combat Focus and work through them quickly before it ends. The shooting range is good practice for the aiming, but the trophy needs real enemies, so pick a fight with enough targets grouped up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — get a plane airborne from VCIA without a scheduled flight. Get airside, take a plane and take off from the runway; expect a wanted level on the way out, so go at speed and climb fast once you are up.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke in itself — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the trophy is about the Rhino tank: get into one and put it through its paces. Military vehicles appear around bases and in high-wanted-level responses; once you have a Rhino, drive it and use it until the trophy pops.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when staff are looking away, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted the attempt fails for this trophy, so back out and retry — a detected robbery still counts toward the robbery totals, just not toward Sneakthief.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the big free-roam robberies: plan the getaway car before you go in, hit the vault, and escape the wanted level to bank the count. Five successful escapes are needed, so treat each one like Retail Therapy — route first, speed second, and never stop to fight on the way out.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. Ram it off the road or block it, work fast once it is stopped, and have your getaway car ready before the police close in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the farmland and the small towns. Drive the whole map rather than fast-travelling: the trophy tracks the regions you have actually visited. Combine it with WAiNK check-ins and vehicle discovery so the same road trip advances three trophies at once.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Gangs run their own operations in different territories — find one operation per gang, hit it and get out. Work through the gang territories one at a time and keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed, so the last one is easy to find.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is a quiet moment trophy, a nod to the series' past, so sit through the drink rather than rushing off. It pops once the scene plays out.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, get up to speed, and aim for the glass frontage. It is a one-off stunt moment, so expect a wanted level and a repair bill afterwards.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a game there. The alley is a playable activity spot: rent a lane, play through the frames, and the trophy pops for the follow-through. It is another quiet callback trophy, so no score target is needed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and the community is still pinning down the exact trigger after launch. It reads as a social-media or partnership moment with your in-game partner, so play the partner activities and story beats that build your public profile together. Check the linked lists for the confirmed trigger as guides update.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — this trophy is tied to a story choice in the campaign. Play through the story and make a decision at the choice point the game offers; the trophy pops once the choice is made. Keep a manual save before the final mission so you can see the other outcome without replaying the whole story.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this trophy pops when something works on the second attempt. The launch lists do not yet agree on the exact trigger, and it reads as a retry moment: fail an attempt at something once, then succeed on the immediate retry. If it does not pop during natural play, check the linked lists for the confirmed trigger as guides update.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the description is the reaction the trophy wants. It reads as an easter-egg or strange-encounter trophy: find one of Leonida's odd events out in the world and see it through. Roam the rural and coastal oddities, follow anything that looks out of place, and check the linked lists for the confirmed encounter as guides update.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a group on foot, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and send them flying like pins. A crowded sidewalk at low speed is the safest setup; high speed makes the timing much harder.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations — and your contacts turn them into clean money over time. Keep robbing and laundering in rotation: the total is cumulative, so it builds alongside Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control without a separate grind.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and anything else the shops sell, counted cumulatively. Do not save this for a single shopping spree: buy gear, ammo and outfits as you play and the total climbs on its own. Late in the game, expensive weapons and wardrobe pieces are the fastest way to close the last gap.

sources.name: Planet GTA 6 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles cross-check)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought from the in-game property listings — check the map and the property app for unsold garages, and buy each one. The money comes from the robbery and laundering loop, so finish Maximum Withdrawal and Dime on the Dollar first and this becomes affordable.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you want to keep — the ones you discover for Whip It Good are good candidates — and register each one in the app instead of leaving it on the street. Ten registrations is the whole requirement; the app keeps the list, so you can see your progress there.
